name: The Cookie Aisle
tagline: A hand picked selection of our favorite cookies & sweets!
description:
Let's make a few assumptions...you like cookies & you also know someone who really likes cookies. As we do, you also enjoy being surrounded by hundreds of packaged cookies & sweets that appeal to most, if not all of your cookie cravings. We don't grow out of this folks, and that's a good thing. If you know someone like this/us, then they will love this gift. You choose your budget, we choose the cookies. The number of packages and the variety will vary with the dollar amount. Mulino Bianco, Stroopwaffles, Confectionally Yours Toffee, Nutella, Ghiottini Cantucci, seasonal favorites...the list goes on!

*This is a gift, so we will remove the prices!

name: Butternubs Salted Brown Butter Sables, 204g
description:
Rich and buttery with light caramel notes, and the perfect sweet-salty balance for an addictive treat, this is the cookie that started it all! Butternub's French-style shortbreads are handmade at their bakery with only premium pantry ingredients like European style butter, unbleached flour and real vanilla beans.

Each generous box weighs nearly half a pound and contains twelve (12) individually wrapped cookies for freshness (and let's be honest - gentle portion control, because you're going to want to eat them all!)

name: Butternubs Salted Chocolate Sables, 204g
description:
Exquisitely dark cocoa shortbreads with the perfect sweet-salty balance and a tender crumb that melts in your mouth. Butternub's French-style shortbreads are handmade at their bakery with only premium pantry ingredients like European style butter, unbleached flour and real vanilla beans.

Each generous box weighs nearly half a pound and contains twelve (12) individually wrapped cookies for freshness (and let's be honest - gentle portion control, because you're going to want to eat them all!)

name: DeLaurenti Classic Chocolate Chip Cookie
description: A lot has been said about this cookie. We think it's the best around. It's won awards and been enjoyed by thousands of our important customers. Buy one, you won't be disappointed.

name: DeLaurenti Chocolate Hazelnut Cookie
description: The fans of this cookie are an elite group. We love them, and we love this cookie. Yes, you can pretend that you are only going to eat half and save the rest for after dinner. There's no judgement here, and there are plenty of roasted hazelnuts for protein.

name: Coop's Hot Fudge Sauce, 10oz
description:
Born in an ice cream shop in Boston, Coop’s has innovated and perfected their rich, smooth hot fudge and caramel recipe variations for more than a decade. Family-owned and crafted in small batches with absolutely no artificial additives or preservatives, every ingredient in every jar of Coop’s is all-natural and meticulously sourced.

Their Original Hot Fudge is instantly rich and impeccably smooth, thick right out of the jar but drizzly once warmed. Great on top of ice cream or in your lattes at home!

name: Coop's Peanut Butter Sauce, 10oz
description:
Born in an ice cream shop in Boston, Coop’s has innovated and perfected their rich, smooth hot fudge and caramel recipe variations for more than a decade. Family-owned and crafted in small batches with absolutely no artificial additives or preservatives, every ingredient in every jar of Coop’s is all-natural and meticulously sourced.

Their Peanut Butter sauce is the condiment you didnt think you needed until you have it. Our staff has been adding it to their morning oatmeal, dipping their afternoon chocolate in it, and taking it home to put on ice cream.

name: Coop's Salted Caramel Sauce, 10oz
description:
Born in an ice cream shop in Boston, Coop’s has innovated and perfected their rich, smooth hot fudge and caramel recipe variations for more than a decade. Family-owned and crafted in small batches with absolutely no artificial additives or preservatives, every ingredient in every jar of Coop’s is all-natural and meticulously sourced.

Their salted caramel sauce has

deep caramelized flavor and precisely the right pop of salt. Great on top of ice cream or in your lattes at home!

name: DeLaurenti Peanutbutter Cookie
description: Our most underrated cookie. A cafe classic. Rich peanut butter with the subtle crunch of flaky sea salt on top...enough said.

name: CiCi's Almond Shortbread Cookies, 8oz
description: We have been Cici's Italian Cookies fans since, well…always. Anytime they have a new product, we HAVE to have it. Shortbread has the bad reputation of being dry and crumbly but these are buttery and dense with the lightest whisper of almond flavor. Perfect alongside your morning coffee, at tea time or for a light dessert!

name: Cici's Chocolate Espresso Cookies, 8oz
description: CiCi's uses only the finest natural ingredients in their Italian cookies and bakes to order 5 days a week. If you can have a double chocolate cookie that is really chocolatey without being too chocolately, this is it. Add a hint of espresso and you'll be on the road to productivity and great ideas! Just like all her other cookies...amazing!

name: CiCi's Ginger Molasses Cookies, 8oz
description: CiCi's uses only the finest natural ingredients in their Italian cookies and bakes to order 5 days a week. These molasses cookies are a joke...we shouldn't be surprised, they are just like all the other cookies that CiCi's makes. Christine Falatico Frey is on a personal mission to stop us from baking for ourselves! Soft & chewy with crackly edges, her Ginger Molasses cookies have just the right amount of ginger spice to balance the rich molasses flavor!

name: CiCi's Italian Birthday Cake Cookies, 8oz
description: CiCi's uses only the finest natural ingredients in their Italian cookies and bakes to order 5 days a week. These cake-like cookies melt in your mouth. Who doesn't like a birthday?! These vanilla cookies with sprinkles taste just like your first piece of cake as a kid!

name: CiCi's Italian Lemon Cookies, 8oz
description: CiCi's uses only the finest natural ingredients in their Italian cookies and bakes to order 5 days a week. These cake-like cookies melt in your mouth. They are made with lemon juice in the dough and frosting to achieve the perfect level of lemony sweetness. Beautifully packaged, if you can keep from eating them yourself, they also make a fantastic gift!

name: CiCi's Original Italian Butterhorns, 8oz
description: CiCi's uses only the finest natural ingredients in their Italian cookies and bakes to order 5 days a week. These hand-rolled Italian cookies are made from light buttery dough and filled with cinnamon, sugar and walnuts. The rolling technique keeps the cookie center soft and caramelized during baking while the outer shell turns to a flaky golden brown. Beautifully packaged, if you can keep from eating them, they also make a fantastic gift!

name: DeLaurenti Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough, 1#
description: This is the stuff of legend: our famous housemade chocolate chip cookies, baked in the comfort of your own home oven & enjoyed when the chocolate is still warm! Includes 4 portioned balls. Each will make a cafe-sized cookie, or tear them in half for human size! Cook at 350 for 12 to 15 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is light and puffy. Enjoy!

name: Fratelli Lunardi Almond & Candied Lemon Cantucci, 200g
tagline: Not too soft, not too crisp...just right!
description: Ok...simply put, these cantucci are really, really delicious. They are not tooth breakingly crisp and not so soft you can't dunk them without them disintegrating. They hit the textural sweet spot. Oh, and the flavor...snappy almonds, honey and sticky/soft pieces of candied lemon make these cookies almost impossible to stop eating. Seriously, the bottom of the bag gets closer and closer without a whole lot of effort. If that happens to you, don't worry...you will be applauded when we send you more!

They hit the textural sweet spot. Oh, and the flavor...crunchy almonds, honey, citrus & real Italian butter make them the perfect cookie for your coffee or your Vin Santo. You choose the drink, they'll go with anything!

You choose the drink, they'll go with anything!

name: Giovanni Cogno Biscotti di Nocciola al Cioccolato, 300g
tagline: The best hazelnut/chocolate cookies you will ever have...
description: These hazelnut/dark chocolate biscuits are amazing. Not too sweet, they have a light, crunchy/crumbly texture and are made with dark chocolate flecks and 30% PGI hazelnuts from Piedmont. Bite-size and fragrant, they are perfect alone, with a coffee or tea, or a good glass of Moscato. It will take considerable will to not continue to rapid fire them right out of the box.

name: La Florentine Marron Glace, 7oz
description: La Florentine candied chestnuts a sweet/savory treat that will for sure go well with that glass of port or gelato after dinner.

name: Baratti & Milano Caramella Di Torino Classica, 200g
description: The most historic candy produced by Baratti & Milano, was once one of the most famous. This elegant hard candy is made from real fruit. This elegant candy, "Classica Caramella", Classic candy, was created for the first time at Baratti & Milano in 1911, during the International Fair of Turin. A matchless recipe of fresh and delicate flavors natural fruits, gives it it's rich taste. These candies have a classic shape, and unmistakable butterfly "farfalla" wrappings. Their flavors include: strawberry, lemon, mint and bilberry (a European style blueberry).

name: Bonomi Lady Fingers, 500g
description: The Bonomi family has been baking delicious breads and confections since 1850. Often used as an accompaniment to ice-cream, custards and coffee, lady fingers are long, thin cookies designed to turn spongy when soaked in liquor or covered with ice cream. Most notably, they are the critical ingredient in tiramisu - the famous italian dessert consisting of ladyfingers soaked in espresso, mascarpone, liquor and cocoa powder.

name: Confectionately Yours English Toffee, 8oz
description: Made with loving care right here in Seattle by our great friend Sweet Sue - this recipe dates back over 50 years. If you don't believe us, ask anyone who has been lucky enough to be at DeLaurenti when Sweet Sue is kind enough to come down and sample her amazing toffee!! Made by hand using only the finest ingredients, it is easily the best toffee you will ever eat!!

name: Coufidou Prunes, 450g
tagline: Agen Prunes Stuffed with Prunes Mousse
description: The stuffed Prunes of Agen (Pruneaux d’Agen Fourrés) are a classic holiday delicacy, ranking as one of the most prestigious gifts in France. Splendid, full-bodied Agen Prunes are pitted, dried, gently rehydrated, and—delight of delights—filled generously with a smooth purée of their own fruit, delicately flavored with lemon peel and vanilla. Perfect as a sweet foil to cooked game, as a succulent side to foie gras, or served with Armagnac or Banyuls wine at the end of a meal. These prunes also pair beautifully with a cup of Mariage Frères tea for an afternoon treat. Each round tin contains 12 prunes filled with prune mousse.

name: Il Cassero Panforte Bianco, 250g
description: Il Cassero panforte is a dense, traditional Tuscan "strong bread" that has a long history in Tuscany.t is full of nuts, spices, candied fruits, and honey. Pairs well with an aged pecorino or a glass of Vin Santo!

name: Il Cassero Panforte Chocolate & Cherry, 250g
description: Il Cassero panforte is a dense, traditional Tuscan "strong bread" that has a long history in Tuscany. It is full of nuts, spices, candied fruits, and honey, while also featuring chocolate and cherries. Pairs very well with Vin Santo!

name: Il Cassero Panforte Trio, 300g
description: Il Cassero panforte is a dense, traditional Tuscan "strong bread" that has a long history in Tuscany. Can't decide on one flavor? How about a small sampling of each! This pack comes with the classic, fig & chocolate, and a savory version with black pepper.

name: La Florentine Assorted Torrone, 18pc
description: This soft nougat candy has been a mainstay at DeLaurenti for generations. Although this candy is commonly found in the toe of your stocking on Christmas, it is available here at our store the other 364 days of the year as well. Prepared with the finest crunchy almonds, smooth golden honey, pure cane sugar and fluffy egg whites, it will transport you back to your childhood. Each box contains eighteen individually packaged candies - 6 orange, 6 lemon and 6 vanilla.

name: Lu Pim's Orange, 150g
tagline: Not the kind at Walmart! All French!
description: Anyone who can say that they have been doing anything since 1846 is clearly has figured something out. These classic French cookies are a staff favorite. This lightly sweetened biscuit is topped with orange jam, then enrobed in dark chocolate. Impossible to eat just one!

name: Lu Pim's Raspberry, 150g
tagline: Not the kind at Walmart! All French!
description: Anyone who can say that they have been doing anything since 1846 is clearly has figured something out. These classic French cookies are a staff favorite. This lightly sweetened biscuit is topped with raspberry jam, then enrobed in dark chocolate. Impossible to eat just one!

name: Lu Pim's Strawberry, 150g
tagline: Not the kind at Walmart! All French!
description: Anyone who can say that they have been doing anything since 1846 is clearly has figured something out. These classic French cookies are a staff favorite. This lightly sweetened biscuit is topped with strawberry jam, then enrobed in dark chocolate. Impossible to eat just one!

name: San Juan Island Salted Honey Caramels, 113g
description: Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt. Not only do they produce our favorite salt, but they produce fabulous salty caramels made with honey, which gives the caramels a flavor all their own. Cooked by hand in small batches, these caramels will make your mouth sing.

name: San Juan Island Salted Honey Chocolate Caramel, 113g
description: Located in one of the most pristine and beautiful parts of Washington state, San Juan Sea Salt uses greenhouses and sunshine to slowly and naturally evaporate filtered water from the Salish Sea to extract the sea salt. Not only do they produce our favorite salt, but they produce fabulous salty caramels made with honey, which gives the caramels a flavor all their own. For this version, they add a luscious organic dark chocolate to create an unforgettable pairing.

name: Bunches & Bunches Shorties, 256g
tagline: Made with love in Portland, OR!
description: Based in Portland, Bunches & Bunches is a gourmet line of sauces and cookies created by chef Tamalpais Roth-McCormick. Shorties are a celebration of the timeless shortbread cookie. The delicate texture and combination of rich butter and subtle sweetness is something to be had. If it's been awhile since you sat down and ate a few really good shortbread cookies, start again with these!

name: Bunches & Bunches Snaps, 340g
tagline: Made with love in Portland, OR!
description: Based in Portland, Bunches & Bunches is a gourmet line of sauces and cookies created by chef Tamalpais Roth-McCormick. These ginger snaps possess the 3 most important qualities in a really good ginger snap...ginger...snap...& love. Yes, love. People who don't consider themselves ginger snap people love these cookies!

name: Galbusera Gluten Free Chocolate Wafers, 180g
description: Galbusera Gluten Free Zerograno Chocolate Cream Wafer Cookies are crisp, layered wafers filled with smooth chocolate cream. Made without gluten, they offer a light, crunchy texture paired with a rich cocoa flavor. The balanced sweetness and delicate structure make them easy to enjoy at any time of day.

name: Galbusera Gluten Free Cocoa and Hazelnut Wafers, 180g
description: Galbusera Gluten Free Zerograno Hazelnut Cream Wafer Cookies are crisp, layered wafers filled with smooth hazelnut cream. Made without gluten, they offer a light, airy texture balanced by a rich, nutty flavor. The delicate crunch and creamy filling create a classic wafer experience with a refined twist.

name: Galbusera Gluten Free Cocoa Cookies with Vanilla Cream Filling, 160g
Ritrovo Selections Organic Sicilian Marzipan, 8.8oz
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Sicilian Marzipan is a rich, organic puree of almonds and cane sugar. Marzipan, an ancient confection, was likely brought to Sicily from the Middle East by crusaders. Sicilian chefs use it to create decorations for cakes. It’s also an essential ingredient in the best almond cakes and tarts.

name: BonBon Salty Swedish Licorice Twists, 4oz
description:
These Swedish Fish are legit...and they are actually Swedish. BonBon’s new Salty Licorice Twists pay homage to the cultural heritage of BonBon’s three Swedish founders and their lifelong love for this unique candy. The BonBon Twists are a perfectly balanced depth of black licorice flavor with a nuanced taste that ends with a soft salty finish.

Founded in 2017 by three Swedish friends, Selim Adira, Robert Persson, and Leonard Schaltz, BonBon has revolutionized American candy culture with their authentic Swedish candies and delicacies out of their New York global headquarters. Yes. 100% of BonBon’s candy is imported from Sweden.

name: BonBon Sour Elderflower Swedish Fish, 4oz
description:
These Swedish Fish are legit...and they are actually Swedish. They have a perfect texture and are coated in sour sugar. We challenge you to eat just one! Their Sour Elderflower Fish are a tribute to the homemade cordial that was made from freshly picked flowers by their grandparents during Sweden’s short summer months. The elderflower is one of BonBon’s four flavors of summer.

Founded in 2017 by three Swedish friends, Selim Adira, Robert Persson, and Leonard Schaltz, BonBon has revolutionized American candy culture with their authentic Swedish candies and delicacies out of their New York global headquarters. Yes. 100% of BonBon’s candy is imported from Sweden.

name: BonBon Sour Peach Swedish Fish, 4oz
description:
These Swedish Fish are legit...and they are actually Swedish. The Sour Peach Fish is their take on everyone’s favorite summer fruit - a juicy peach! A little bit sweet, a little bit sour, and always refreshing, these will certainly have you reaching for more. The peach is one of BonBon’s five fish flavors!

name: BonBon Sour Pippi Gold Coins, 4oz
description:
These Swedish treats are legit...and they are actually Swedish. Inspired by the adventurous Pippi Longstocking, these Gold Coins are a treasure of tropical flavors! Each coin is a soft, chewy delight, bursting with pineapple and peach-apricot flavors, finished with a tangy sour coating! These sour gummies are summer in a bag!

name: BonBon Sour Wild Strawberry Swedish Fish, 4oz
description:
These Swedish Fish are legit...and they are actually Swedish. These classic Wild Sour Strawberry candies have a perfect texture and are coated in sour sugar. We challenge you to eat just one!

Founded in 2017 by three Swedish friends, Selim Adira, Robert Persson, and Leonard Schaltz, BonBon has revolutionized American candy culture with their authentic Swedish candies and delicacies out of their New York global headquarters. Yes. 100% of BonBon’s candy is imported from Sweden.

name: BonBon Sweet Wild Strawberry Swedish Fish, 4oz
description:
These Swedish Fish are legit...and they are actually Swedish. Their Sweet Wild Strawberry Fish are the epitome of Swedish summers. So juicy and so sweet, these fish will transport you to a field of wild strawberries on a warm and breezy July afternoon. The wild strawberry is one of BonBon’s four flavors of summer!

Founded in 2017 by three Swedish friends, Selim Adira, Robert Persson, and Leonard Schaltz, BonBon has revolutionized American candy culture with their authentic Swedish candies and delicacies out of their New York global headquarters. Yes. 100% of BonBon’s candy is imported from Sweden.

name: Bonomi Amaretti, 200g
description: The Bonomi family has been baking delicious breads and confections since 1850. With a flavor that is reminiscent of childhood, these amaretti cookies are crisp and crunchy on the outside with a soft center. They are excellent eaten as is, with coffee, or dessert wines. They are also perfect crumbled on vanilla ice cream, or into the crust of a delicious amaretti cake.

name: Antonio Mattei Almond Biscotti, 250g
description: Since 1858, Antonio Mattei has been producing Italian biscotti and confections in their historical bakery and shop located on Via Ricasoli, in the heart of the old city of Prato, Tuscany. The bakery has been run by the Pandolfini family for 3 generations. Throughout Tuscany, these biscotti are considered the standard-bearer. Their size, texture and taste are synonymous with quality and tradition. Made only with flour, farm fresh eggs which impart a golden yellow color, sugar, almonds, and pine nuts. Traditionally enjoyed at the end of a meal with a glass of Vin Santo, they are also perfect with coffee, gelato or panna cotta.

name: Dandelion Hot Chocolate Mix, 5.6oz
tagline: Built to withstand foggy cold mornings in SF & Seattle!
description:
Dandelion Chocolate's classic Hot Chocolate is rich, subtly sweet, and deeply chocolatey. Inside each bottle includes the hot chocolate mix made from the 70% Camino Verde, Ecuador single-origin chocolate they use for their house hot chocolate drinks, and, of course, a basic recipe for the home hot chocolate enthusiast.

Each bottle makes four servings.

name: Jonboy Fleur de Sel Caramel Sauce, 8oz
description: Jonboy Caramels started as a side gig for close friends Jonathan Sue and Jason Alm in 2008. Working on a four-burner stove in a small Ballard room, the two friends developed recipes for their unforgettable small batch caramels. They worked with the finest Northwest and organic ingredients available. They knew they were onto something, but few others did. Enter the Ballard Farmers Market, which offered them a stand in 2009. Fast forward a decade and change and their now-famous caramels can be found throughout the region. We’re especially fond of their velvety caramel sauce with just the right touch of French sea salt. Enjoy it with sliced apples, chocolate, and over ice cream!

name: Jonboy Fleur de Sel Caramel, 4oz
description: Jonboy Caramels started as a side gig for close friends Jonathan Sue and Jason Alm in 2008. Working on a four-burner stove in a small Ballard room, the two friends developed recipes for their unforgettable small batch caramels. They worked with the finest Northwest and organic ingredients available. They knew they were onto something, but few others did. Enter the Ballard Farmers Market, which offered them a stand in 2009. Fast forward a decade and change and their now-famous caramels can be found throughout the region. Their Fleur de Sel Caramels are a classic rich caramel with a bit of French Sea Salt to open the taste buds.

name: La Sassellese Amaretti Morbidi, 180g
description: There are crisp, crunchy amaretti, and there are soft, chewy amaretti...both are great and these are the soft and chewy. Rich in the flavor of armelline almonds, and pure sugar and egg white, La Sassallese's aromatic soft amaretti cookies are typical of central Liguria.

name: Primo Pan GF Drolo, 12oz
tagline: Gluten Free Dark Chocolate Hazelnut Cookies!
description: In the village of Battifollo on the Cuneo side of the Ligurian Alps, the Biga family bakes small lots of wonderful cookies according to local recipes. These gluten-free cookies are made with 40% Piedmont hazelnuts, egg white, sugar, cocoa and vanilla. Crunchy and light, this is a flourless cookie that tastes like a chocolate brownie on a cloud. Perfect with a glass of cold or steamed milk or with a caffe latte.

name: Primo Pan GF Volo, 12oz
tagline: Gluten Free Dark Chocolate Almond Cookies!
description: In the village of Battifollo on the Cuneo side of the Ligurian Alps, the Biga family bakes small lots of wonderful cookies according to local recipes. Inspired by Primo Pan's best-selling Drolo Cookies, their new Volo cookies are made with almonds, egg white, sugar, cocoa and vanilla. Crunchy, light, and gluten-free. Pairs well with milk and caffè lattes.

name: CiCi's Cookies - 4 of a Kind
description: Cici's Cookies are among the best selling cookies in our store, and for good reason. They are delicious! If you are having a hard time choosing, well...you know have to! This is all 4 standard flavors: Classic Lemon, Butterhorn, Ginger Molasses & Chocolate Espresso!. Great for you, and GREAT as a gift!

name: Dutch Brothers Caramel Cookie Waffles, 9oz
description: With all respect to the Dutch masters that created this famed cookie, we love the ones from Montana. Matt found these during a bike ride through Montana! It was the perfect pick me up - and it fits nicely in a jersey pocket! Upon his return to the shop, he simply stated "we needed these stroopwafels." Now we can say that you also need these stroopwafels. Enjoy them right out of the package, or place them on the lip of your hot cup of coffee or tea and allow the molten center to warm before enjoying!

name: Lazzaroni Amaretti di Saronno Amaretti Snaps, 7oz
description: From the folks that know their amaretti. These cookies are crisp and snappy as the name would suggest. A perfet compliment to a bowl of vanilla gelato/ice cream, or crumbled on the top of your tiramisu for a amaretti-filled crunchy victory!

name: Lazzaroni Amaretti di Saronno Box, 200g
description: Since 1718, the Lazzaroni family has crafted amaretti cookies according to their family's traditional recipe. Individually wrapped in pairs with their distinctive paper, these crisp and airy cookies are perfect with coffee, wine or after dinner liqueurs.

name: Lazzaroni Amaretti di Saronno Box, 65g
description: Since 1718, the Lazzaroni family has crafted amaretti cookies according to their family's traditional recipe. Individually wrapped in pairs with their distinctive paper, these crisp and airy cookies are perfect with coffee, wine or after dinner liqueurs.

description: Since 1718, the Lazzaroni family has crafted amaretti cookies according to their family's traditional recipe. Individually wrapped in pairs with their distinctive paper, these crisp and airy cookies are perfect with coffee, wine or after dinner liqueurs.

name: Barbero Gianduiotto Classico, 150g
tagline: Smooth milk chocolate with hazelnut cream from the Piedmont!
description: Classic giandujotto from Barbero in the Piedmont! Smooth milk chocolate with hazelnuts that literally melts in your mouth! Add the cool decorative tin and you're out of excuses!

name: Ferrero Italian Nutella, 400g
description: Ok...this is the real stuff. No plastic, no English, with all due respect to plastic & English, both useful at times, but neither should be surrounding your Nutella. Straight from the motherland where the chocolate and hazelnets meet to become greater than the sum of their parts. We don't need to tell you how to use it, put it on anything you would like if you want to make it better, particularly a Mulino Bianco cookie!

name: Rabitos Dark Chocolate Fig Bonbons, 142g
description: Rabitos Royale Dark Chocolate Fig Bonbons are an amazing product. Raquel and Señador Valero conceived of this extraordinary treat while living among the fig trees of a small village in southwestern Spain. They select tender young figs from the neighboring groves and fill them with a mousse made of dark chocolate and a hint of brandy. Each one is then hand dipped in even more rich dark chocolate! Finally each individual bonbon is sealed in a foil envelope so that it will always taste as fresh as the day they were made. They make an amazing gift, to someone you love, or to yourself!

name: Primopan Foglie di Mais Corn Cookies, 334g
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Crunchy Corn Cookies (Foglie di Mais) are a light, not-too-sweet cookie that is perfect with coffee, tea and sweet wines like vin santo or Moscato d’Asti. They are so delicate, that there are always a few broken ones in the package. Don't worry...the pieces taste just as good as the whole ones.

name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Soft Torrone Bites w/Hazelnuts, 5oz
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Soft Torrone Bites with Hazelnuts are light and chewy bite-sized made chunks of traditional nougat sweetened with Abruzzese honey and studded with hazelnuts.

name: Ritrovo Selections Sicilian Pistachio Cream, 8oz
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Pistachio Cream is obsession worthy. It’s made with just two ingredients: cane sugar and organic Sicilian pistachios from the foothills of Mount Etna, where the best pistachios in the world are grown. This pure, sweet spread is used in Italy for pastries, cake fillings, and gelati. But you’ll probably find yourself spreading it on toast or just eating it straight from the jar.

name: Amarelli Senatori Soft Licquorice Flavored With Anise, 100g
description: Enjoy a taste of Italy with Amarelli Assabesi Licorice Gummies! These bright black candies are bursting with the typical and persistent flavor of gummy licorice, without any preservatives, colorings, or additives. Packaged in 100g boxes, these gummies are sure to satisfy any licorice lover. Made in Italy.

name: Amarelli Senatori Soft Licquorice Flavored With Violet, 100g
description: Sporting one of the most peculiar flavors of the Amarelli line, Senatori alla Violetta are soft licorice candies with a slight hint of violet. Their intense floral aroma is guaranteed to linger a long time in your mouth.

name: BonBon Moomin Candy Clouds, 115g
description:
Soft, foamy pillows of candy clouds lightly coated in sour sugar exuding real strawberry and blueberry notes. The Candy Clouds evoke the quieter comforts of the Moomin universe—rest, warmth, and the reassurance of feeling safe.

Founded in 2017 by three Swedish friends, Selim Adira, Robert Persson, and Leonard Schaltz, BonBon has revolutionized American candy culture with their authentic Swedish candies and delicacies out of their New York global headquarters. Yes. 100% of BonBon’s candy is imported from Sweden.

name: BonBon Moomin Sour Candy Gummies, 115g
description:
Shaped like beloved Moomin characters, these playful sour gummies feature a bright mix of flavors, including lemon, raspberry, cola, and melon. These lightly sugared Moomin trolls deliver a more refined sour bite and balance than any of the current candy-aisle classics.

Founded in 2017 by three Swedish friends, Selim Adira, Robert Persson, and Leonard Schaltz, BonBon has revolutionized American candy culture with their authentic Swedish candies and delicacies out of their New York global headquarters. Yes. 100% of BonBon’s candy is imported from Sweden.

name: Bonne Maman Chocolate Caramel Tartlet, 135g
description:
The secret to this classic French brand is simple—great ingredients. Bonne Maman

(“Grandmother”) uses time-honored French recipes, natural ingredients, and the best

fruit in their products. Their Tartelettes Chocolat Caramel are seriously delicious. Silky

rich caramel is topped with crunchy milk chocolate in a crisp, buttery crust. To preserve

flavor and crispness, each Bonne Maman chocolate caramel tart is carefully packaged

in its small fresh bag. Excellent as an after-dinner treat or with an afternoon coffee or

tea.

name: Bonne Maman Lemon Tartlet, 135g
description: The secret to this classic French brand is simple—great ingredients. Bonne Maman (“Grandmother”) uses time-honored French recipes, natural ingredients, and the best fruit in their products. Their Tartelettes Citron feature a velvety lemon filling in a deliciously crisp, buttery crust. Individually wrapped, the tartelettes have a superb citrus flavor and make an indulgent treat with an afternoon coffee or tea.

name: Bonne Maman Raspberry Tartlet, 135g
description:
The secret to this classic French brand is simple—great ingredients. Bonne Maman

(“Grandmother”) uses time-honored French recipes, natural ingredients, and the best

fruit in their products. Their Tartelettes Framboise may not rival your French

grandmother’s raspberry tart, but they’re about as close as you can get in a cookie. A

buttery, crisp shell is filled with a tart-sweet raspberry filling. The nine individually

wrapped tartelettes make great tea cookies, a light dessert, or a mid-afternoon pick-me-

up.

name: Cannoli Shells 3", 8 ct
description: These traditional 3" mini cannoli shells are poised and ready to hand you back the hours that it would otherwise take you to make them on your own! No shame in allocating those resources to the filling or the many other tasks that are on your list. Just pipe & enjoy!

name: Cannoli Shells 5", 4 ct
description: These traditional 5" cannoli shells are poised and ready to hand you back the hours that it would otherwise take you to make them on your own! No shame in allocating those resources to the filling or the many other tasks that are on your list. Just pipe & enjoy!

name: Carambar Caramels, 130g
description: The individually wrapped Carambar caramel lolly has been a favourite of French kids since the 1950’s. And French adults are easily tempted too – there’s nothing like Carambar to bring back childhood memories or create new ones.

name: Ciacco Baci di Dama, 170g
description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Baci di Dama is the classic Piedmont melt-in-your-mouth hazelnut sandwich cookie. Two tender hazelnut cookies hug a rich dollop of chocolate-hazelnut cream.

name: Ciacco Brutti ma Buoni, 120g
description: Made with only three ingredients: Piedmont IGP hazelnuts, egg white, and sugar, this naturally gluten free delight is perfect from summer all the way to holiday time. The Italian name translates to "ugly but delicious" and their nutty aroma, crunchy texture, and lightness are truly a thing of beauty!

name: DeLaurenti Candied French Lemon Strips, 4oz
description: These French candied lemon strips are the best. They are the ones that sit on top of your freshly prepared canoli in our cafe. They are also the ones that can be chopped up and used in cookies and eaten right from the container!

name: DeLaurenti Candied French Orange Strips, 4oz
description: These French candied orange strips are the best. They are the ones that sit on top of your freshly prepared canoli in our cafe. They are also the ones that can be chopped up and used in cookies and eaten right from the container!

name: Ferrero Nutella B-Ready, 6pk
tagline: You don't need to get ready, you stay ready!
description: You don't need to get ready, because you stay ready. These crunchy little wafer cookies piped with creamy nutella are the same way. 6 individual cookies, individually wrapped for readiness!

name: Fogliani Anise Pizzelle, 5oz
description: Never had a pizzelle cookie you say? Time to change that. These classic anise cookies from Abruzzo are made by pouring batter in a pizzelle iron and cooking them like a waffle. They are light, delicate & slightly crunchy. Nate's Nona used to make these and cover half in chocolate making a special Nona-style "sandwich." They are one of Nate's all time favorites...soon to be yours too!

name: Fogliani Vanilla Pizzelle, 5oz
description: Never had a pizzelle cookie you say? Time to change that. These classic vanilla cookies from Abruzzo are made by pouring batter in a pizzelle iron and cooking them like a waffle. They are light, delicate & slightly crunchy. Nate's Nona used to make these and cover half in chocolate making a special Nona-style "sandwich." They are one of Nate's all time favorites...soon to be yours too!

name: Gavottes Crepe Dentelle Dark Chocolate, 90g
description: We aren't sure how you make a cookie this light, crisp and delicious. The answer to this mystery has been a closely held secret by the folks at Gavottes in Brittany since 1920. As legend goes, these cookies are the result of a pancake left too long on the stove by Marie-Catherine Cornic in Quimper, in 1893. When she folded it, rolled it up and popped it in her mouth, the crispy Brittany crepe was born! Enrobed in dark chocolate, these crispy Crepe Dentelles are perfect right out of the box, or as an accompaniment to vanilla ice cream.

name: Gavottes Crispy Crepe Biscuits Milk Chocolate, 90g
description: Gavottes, so the story goes, began with a mistake—an overcooked crepe. But when the crepe was rolled and cool, it was delightfully crispy. So popular was the biscuit that emerged, it has been a French favorite for a century. Still made by the same company in Brittany, the buttery biscuits are light and golden. Chocolate lovers will rejoice at the combination of flaky biscuit and milk chocolate. Perfect with champagne, tea, coffee and ice cream. Or live on the edge and steal one midday.

name: Gavottes Crispy Crepes, 125g
description: Gavottes, so the story goes, began with a mistake—an overcooked crepe. But when the crepe was rolled and cool, it was delightfully crispy. So popular was the biscuit that emerged, it has been a French favorite for a century. Still made by the same company in Brittany, the buttery biscuits are light and golden and flaky. Wrapped by twos in gold foil, Gavottes add a refined touch to ice cream or make a great accompaniment to coffee, tea, or champagne.

name: Little Belgians Speculoos Cookies, 136g
description: These buttery speculoos cookies are thin, crunchy, and not too sweet. Flavored with nine spices including cinnamon, cloves, pepper, and cardamom, and blended lightly with organic brown sugar, they are great with coffee, tea, and hot chocolate. Little Belgians Original Speculoos pair perfectly with chilled Riesling, Prosecco, Chardonnay, and Rose. Of course, they are also an ideal snack all on their own! Each gabled box contains a heat sealed bag with 16 cookies.

name: Maison Colibri Hazelnut Madeleine with Milk Chocolate. 156g
description:
Founded 130 years ago in the medieval town of Pons in southwestern France, Maison Colibri has remained dedicated to making irresistible madeleines into the 21st century.

These are Maison Colibri's signature cookies, and they come individually wrapped, ready for a treat on the go!

name: Masini Almond Cantuccini IGP, 1kg
description: Masini started as a family owned bakery just outside of Florence in 1929. Still family owned, they make classic Tuscan biscotti using the highest quality almonds & chocolate. These classic IGP almond biscotti are ready to eat as is, or be dipped into your morning cappucino or post-meal Vin Santo!

name: Masini Almond Cantuccini IGP, 200g
description: Masini started as a family owned bakery just outside of Florence in 1929. Still family owned, they make classic Tuscan biscotti using the highest quality almonds & chocolate. These classic IGP almond biscotti are ready to eat as is, or be dipped into your morning cappucino or post-meal Vin Santo!

name: Masini Dark Chocolate Cantuccini, 200g
description: Masini started as a family owned bakery just outside of Florence in 1929. Still family owned, they make classic Tuscan biscotti using the highest quality almonds & chocolate. These classic IGP dark chocolate biscotti are ready to eat as is, or be dipped into your morning cappucino or post-meal Vin Santo!

name: Mirzam Emirati Honeycomb Chocolate, 125g
tagline: chunks of Emirati honey dipped in dark chocolate
description: Mirzam Chocolates, named for a star historically used for navigation, holds the honor of being Dubai’s first bean-to-bar chocolate maker. Inspired by the historical spice trade of the region, Mirzam’s bars combine excellent cacao, traditional practices, and unique spice blends inspired by Emirati cuisine and culture. Their honeycomb is made with freshly produced Emirati Honey, cracked into delicious chunks and coated with their bean to bar produced single origin 62% Dark Chocolate.

name: Mirzam Spice Route Caramels, 100g
tagline: Gooey butter caramels dipped in dark & white chocolate
description: Mirzam Chocolates, named for a star historically used for navigation, holds the honor of being Dubai’s first bean-to-bar chocolate maker. Inspired by the historical spice trade of the region, Mirzam’s bars combine excellent cacao, traditional practices, and unique spice blends inspired by Emirati cuisine and culture. These caramels are a combination of their selection of infused and spiced gooey butter caramels, coated in dark, white and caramelised white chocolate.

name: Mitica Chococherries, 5oz
description: Fernando, Manuel and Pepe Caro are third-generation chocolate makers, from Aragon, Spain. If you are a fruit & chocolate lover, these are in your lane. Chococherries are light colored, dye free cherries that are candied in a mix of sugar and local liqueur - they are then dipped in luxurious dark chocolate.

name: Mitica Chocohigos, 5oz
description: Fernando, Manuel and Pepe Caro are third-generation chocolate makers, from Aragon, Spain. If you are a fruit & chocolate lover, these are in your lane. ChocoHigos are soft and luscious Pajarero figs hand dipped in dark chocolate. These figs, native to Spain, are juicy, delicate, and soft in the center with a delicous chocolate shell.

name: Mitica Orange Delights, 5oz
description: Fernando, Manuel and Pepe Caro are third-generation chocolate makers, from Aragon, Spain. These Orange Delights will challenge anyone who has ever made the commitment to keep their fruit away from their chocolate. That's what you get when you hand dip expertly candied Valencia orange slices in luscious 56% chocolate. Great as a ready made dessert with coffee, as a cake garnish, or for no other reason than the fact that you would like something delicious to eat.

name: Mitica Sbrisolona, 10.5oz
description: Sbrisolona (sbrih-zo-LOAN-ah) is a traditional baked almond cookie from Mantova, Italy. It is satisfyingly crunchy, crumbly, and nutty, thanks to cornmeal and almonds. This one comes from Mantova’s oldest bakery, run by the Freddi family since 1923. One of the best cookies that you have NEVER had, give it a go!

name: Mulino Bianco Abbracci, 350g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! Abracci means "hug" in Italian. In this case, the two sides hugging are lightly sweetened shortbread of cream and cocoa!

name: Mulino Bianco Campagnole, 700g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! These lightly sweetened biscuits are made with rice flour, although they are not gluten free. Great with your morning coffee or tea, or along side some good chocolate!

name: Mulino Bianco Canestrini, 200g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! These lightly sweetened shortbread cookies are dusted with a light "veil" of icing sugar. Great with your morning coffee or tea!

name: Mulino Bianco Chicche, 200g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! Chicche are round chocolate cookies with a soft center of chocolate creme!

name: Mulino Bianco Galletti, 350g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! These plain cream biscuits have flecks of crunchy sugar crystals with great texture. Not too sweet, a perfect marriage with some real Italian Nutella!

name: Mulino Bianco Girotondi, 350g
description: Girotondi are a must have with Italian Nutella! The wagon wheel rolls into your life and she never leaves! Also great on their own!

name: Mulino Bianco Macine, 400g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! You can think of Macine as your breakfast cookie. Lightly sweetened and enriched with fresh cream, you can eat them like cereal, or enjoy them with coffee or tea! Spread of Nutella optional...or not.

name: Mulino Bianco Nascondini, 330g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! What's not to like about a shortbread cookie filled with a piece of really good dark chocolate? Nothing.

name: Mulino Bianco Pan di Stelle Biscotto, 350g
description: Mulino Bianco is one of Italy's most popular cookie makers. Decorated with little glazed stars, these hazelnut-chocolate cookies are light, crisp, and not overly sweet. With no partially hydogenated oil, and no artificial flavors or sweetners, they are practicall good for you! Perfect for kids and adults alike - try dipping them in milk or coffee, crumbling on ice cream or eating straight out of the bag!

name: Mulino Bianco Pan di Stelle Crema, 6oz
description: Ok, we know you love the cookies, but have you had the spread? If the answer is yes, you get it. If it was no, then you must try it! No palm oil or junk here...just 100% Italian hazelnuts, cream, cocoa & crushed Pan di Stelle cookies!

name: Mulino Bianco Pannocchie, 350g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! Shaped like little ears of corn for dramatic presentation & made with corn flour, these lightly sweetened cookies are perfect to scoop the velvety foam from your morning cappucino!

name: Mulino Bianco Rigoli, 400g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! Made with Italian honey, these lightly sweetened Rigoli cookies are little work horses. Perfect for a spread of Nutella, with your morning coffee, or right out of the bag!

name: Mulino Bianco Ritornelli, 700g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! These tiger striped beauties are a national treasure. Made with cocoa & almond, they are light, crunchy and perfectly sweet. Visualize the open bag on the counter after dinner with various sets of hands making sure the quality of the bag is acceptable.

name: Mulino Bianco Settembrini, 250g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. And guess what? They are all correct! Filled with fig jam, these little Settembrini are perfect for the fig lovers!

name: Mulino Bianco Spicchi di Sole, 400g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. The perfect little piece of shortbread, Spicchi di Sole are oven baked and made with high quality butter & fresh eggs. Great with coffee!

name: Mulino Bianco Tarallucci, 350g
description: Mulino Bianco cookies are an Italian classic. A staple on the shelves of virtually every grocery store in the country, everyone swears their favorite variety is the best. Made with fresh eggs & high quality butter, these lightly sweetened Tarallucci cookies are the backdrop for anything you want. Nutella, Pan di Stelle Creme, whipped cream, coffee, tea...you get the point.

name: Papadopoulos Caprice Wafers Cocoa & Hazelnut, 400g
description: We sell fancier things here at the store, but not a lot of them taste better than these wafers. Filled with a creamy filling of cocoa and hazelnut, one is never enough. Stick them into a bowl of vanilla ice cream, use them to decorate cakes, or eat them right out of the can.

name: Perugina Baci, 4.4oz
description: Baci means "kiss" in Italian. It should also mean "good chocolate with a whole hazelnut, hazelnut cream and a complimentary love note written in three languages." Stuff stockings, put them out in a bowl on the kitchen table, or hide them for yourself in an undisclosed location within your home.

name: Rinati Brigidini, 200g
description: Since the late 1800s, Rinati has been producing the classic Brigidino following the traditional Tuscan recipe. They are crisp and not too sweet with a unique aniseed aroma. If you have a nonna, you have seen her eating these.

name: Rinati Cialde de Montecatini, 225g
description: These Cialde di Montecatini (waffles of Montecatini) are a Tuscan specialty perfectly suited for coffee, gelato or cocktails! Old school confection at it's best.These aren't your I-hop waffles folks. They are 2 thin, crisp wafers sandwiching a thin layer of not too sweet crumbly almond paste. They will crumble, but then you will pick up all the crumbles and enjoy eating them.

name: Terra Siciliae Pistachio Cream 35% with Sicilian Pistachio, 190g
description: This Sicilian Pistachio cream is 35% pistachios and Gluten Free!
